steps.content: Red warning lights pulse relentlessly. Where light and shadow warp and blur, space itself grows ever more unstable. The initial fissures were barely the size of a person, but the new ones tearing open are more than massive enough for colossal Underground Puppets to force their way through.

The rifts rip through the station walls, hurling fragments of metal and stone into the void. Meanwhile, Mania concentration continues to spike. Your power, too, surges in the contaminated atmosphere, allowing you to hold back the enemy's advance for a moment.

But this is hardly good news. Once the Observation Hub, engineered to the highest Mania defense standards, is breached, there'll be no way to close the existing fissures. Worse yet, the endless tide of Underground Puppets will inevitably overwhelm what remains of the security line.
Over the long-range comms, voices from observation stations across the network rise and clash in mounting chaos.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Zone Three, pressure's spiking, requesting backup! Shields are about to give. The Mania field's gone completely unstable!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Enya's team is moving into position, but... where's Lemma? Lemma, do you copy?
The distant boom of explosions and crashing metal echoes in the background. Then, a girl's voice cuts sharply through the noise.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Get moving, Lemma! Quit slacking!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Slacking?! Me?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ??? When did you even get here?!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I'll be fine! Just worry about yourself!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Those damned Undergrounders... They're not even bothering with the act this time. Launching a direct invasion is one thing, but they're also using my dimensional fissures against me...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This is a direct challenge! They're throwing down the gauntlet at me. Of course I'm picking it up!

Fissures flicker and swell in every corner of the Observation Hub, merging ceaselessly into vast, gaping breaches. Through these tears, the warped, overlapping chaos of Mania dimensions looms behind the surging horde. The enemy has taken your technology and turned it against you, wielding it with far greater mastery.

steps.speaker: Warning
steps.content: Warning: Mania shield efficiency declining to 62%... 58%... 52%...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...The shields are degrading too fast. This depletion rate is abnormal! Activate backup defenses, now!

Lemma's fingers frantically fly across her terminal, rapidly mobilizing every single piece of experimental equipment within the Observation Hub. She's managing to hold the defensive line while simultaneously wrestling the unknown adversary for control of the fissures.
Just then, several unfamiliar error reports flash onto the screen. She freezes for a split second, then grits her teeth and throws herself back into the fight.

steps.speaker: Warning
steps.content: Caution: Shield depletion approaching 70%. Estimated complete failure in 30 seconds. Countdown initiated... 30, 29...
The light barrier cast by the shielding units slowly dims, its glow growing fainter by the second. Meanwhile, error reports continue to pile up on her terminal screen at an alarming rate.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Tch... Like hell I'm losing this!

As Lemma desperately fights to hold her ground, the light before you suddenly dims. An exceptionally massive puppet flickers between the fissures, blinking in and out of existence as it closes the distance to the glowing barrier almost instantaneously.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lemma, get back!

You seize the initiative. A torrent of overflowing Potestas power surges, brutally pinning the puppet in place. Black fragments and a foul stench scatter through the air around you, followed by the familiar, piercing sting of Mania.

The puppet's twisted limbs remain paralyzed, barely a step away from Lemma's terminal. A few meters closer, and the entire operations console would be obliterated. Lemma knows this as well as you do, and her small frame tremors at the thought of it. Still, she refuses to back down.

There's no time left. The situation has spiraled completely out of control. You need to reach the one person who can actually take command, but the encrypted channel seems to be jammed by the dimensional chaos, and the contact you struck that deal with still gives no response.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Schorl of EDGE-07, protect your owner! She's in danger!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...? How do you know about...

You're too busy driving the puppet back toward the defensive line to answer her right now. But you can still feel the panic radiating off her, the sheer overwhelm. She doesn't belong on a battlefield like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You need to go. I'll hold the line!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...No. I am not a child.
A faint quiver lingers beneath her instinctive retort. You sigh inwardly and speak to her in earnest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This has nothing to do with being a child or not. You're a scientist. Your battlefield isn't here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're someone who's supposed to push into the darkest frontiers, for the sake of humanity. Not get dragged down fighting filth that should've been left far behind.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I refuse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't allow you to get hurt!

You shove open the control room door, seize her hand, and try to force her into the seat to strap her down. However, with just a single lapse in your attention, she slips free from your grip, spins around, and hits a few keys. The console locks down. The safety restraints snap shut, and you can't pry them open again.
When you turn back, Lemma is rising unsteadily to her feet. Her body is still trembling, but the hesitation in her eyes is now gone.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I'm the head of the Observation Hub. The equipment, the data, and everyone's safety—all of it falls on me. I'm not running away!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Besides, it hasn't come to that yet.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Come out, Keylan-II!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ???? Key what?? What did you just call this Schorl?!
Her black triangle zips out from her pocket. There, dangling incongruously from the lower tip of the sleek, high-tech bot is a... cute little figurine.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Activate emergency safety protocols. Grant administrator access. Locate the nearest available secondary terminals.

steps.speaker: Keylan-II (?)
steps.content: (Processing. User appears to be in a hurry...) Command received. Initiating emergency search across all Observation Hub sectors for available secondary terminals.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Found them! Three terminals nearby are still intact. Knew my design would work! The layered isolation kept the damage contained. Now I just need to link to any one of them, and we can reboot the anti-Mania barrier and take back control of the fissure generator.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't do this alone. At least wait for actual backup, not—

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: By then it'll be too late. I've got Keylan-II backing me up. Just hold out for sixty seconds. Sixty seconds is all I need to restore the link.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sixty seconds?! That shield's barely going to hold for a few more seconds! You'll be completely exposed! Those puppets—

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Fine. I was a little shaken. Just a little. Don't you dare write me off because of that, SHP-13. Like you, EDGE-07 is also a core force in humanity's fight against Mania.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: We hold our position, buy time, and counterattack. The odds of success are no lower than 70%—that's my rational assessment. If a 70% chance can secure BR-003, provide us with firsthand intelligence on the enemy, and advance our chances of victory and progress, then that's sufficient. Besides...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Those are just some Underground Puppets... I'm the genius of a new generation. Humanity's greatest scientist.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: No way in hell I'm losing!

steps.speaker: Warning
steps.content: 0. Shield fully deactivated.
As the shield shuts down completely, the protective barrier of light fades to nothing. In the distance, more giant puppets let out low, menacing growls.
Fifty seconds left. You have to hold this ground and wait for Lemma to deliver on her promise—
